svg.title: Each form of definition recovers less of the program than the one above it
svg.desc: Six horizontal bars of equal total length. From top to bottom they are the code, an executable specification, a checked specification, a property test, an example test, and a prose requirement. The solid blue part of each bar is what the definition brings back and it shrinks toward the bottom. The light gray remainder is the information the implementer has to supply.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each definition recovers less of the program than the last

svg.text: The bar is the whole program; the solid part is what the definition brings back
